## Change

Describe the problem, implementation and any compatibility or migration impact.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results. Mark unavailable checks explicitly.
Include non-sensitive screenshots for UI changes.

## Review

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated junk or private plans are included.
- [ ] Licensing and third-party attribution are preserved.
